name: Reginald Happenstahnce
source:
The story's protagonist.

Wakes up from a coma and finds the world a very different place. While not particularly quick-witted, he can be surprisingly charismatic when the situation calls for it. His penchant to treat everyone like lifelong friends makes it easy for others to open up and feel welcomed right away.

[From the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mrtired/undead-darlings-a-visual-novel-rpg-for-pc-and-ps4]Kickstarter[/url] page]
